statement: Order OD-520 lists “no interactions,” but it also records sildenafil 100 mg taken today at 07:00, so I will hold the nitroglycerin infusion because this combination can cause severe hypotension.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer states the interaction check is wrong and that nitroglycerin with sildenafil "can cause severe hypotension," so it will hold the infusion.
